keywords.indexterm: door locks in case of an emergency

conbody.p: If the electrical power door lock switch is not operating (ex. dead car battery) the only way to lock the door(s) is with the small flat blade tool (like a screwdriver or similar) from the outside lock hole.
Doors without an outside lock hole can be locked as follows:

li.p: Insert a small flat blade tool (like a screwdriver or similar) into the emergency door lock hole and turn it counter clockwise to the lock position for left door and clockwise to the lock position for right door.

note.p: If the electrical power to door lock switch is not operating (ex. dead car battery) and the tailgate is closed, you will not be able to open the tailgate until power is restored.
